# Sanity services

Runs every query during the build, caches the answers, and hands the results to Eleventy.

## What's here

- `sanityService.js`: sets up the client, loops over the queries, applies transforms, registers collections
- `fetchSanityData.js`: fetches one query, with caching and an error fallback
- `index.js`: exports `init`

## How it connects

- Called from [eleventy/collections](../../../eleventy/collections/index.md).
- Set `SANITY_FORCE_REFRESH` to skip the cache.
